facts.text: SDSU is South Dakota's largest higher education institution and the only college or university in the nation with a Jackrabbit mascot.

sources.title: Division of Budget and Finance | South Dakota State University
sources.quote: SDSU is South Dakota's largest higher education institution.

sources.title: University Traditions - South Dakota State University
sources.quote: Regardless of the origins of the name of the mascot, SDSU is the only college or university in the nation with a Jackrabbit as its mascot.
